question.prompt: What are the median and mode of the data 2, 3, 3, 5, 9? (Write the median followed by the mode, separated by a comma.)

solutions.explanation: The data are already sorted. The middle value is 3, so the median is 3. The value 3 occurs twice, more often than any other value, so the mode is 3.
solutions.title: Identify the middle and most frequent values
